source.work: Arthur Henderson Smith, Chinese Characteristics (New York/Chicago: Fleming H. Revell, 1894)
source.public_domain_basis: Published 1894; author died 1932; IA library scan (americana/cdl collections). Copyright status: public domain in the US (pre-1930 publication).
source.independence: Different book, author, publisher and scan from The Chinese Recorder Vol.27 (1896) used in P14-P16.

pages_rule: Six PDF pages spread across the volume, fixed before any OCR of this book: 52, 100, 148, 196, 244, 292.

substitutions.reason: PDF 196 is a full-page photographic plate (Interior of a Mohammedan Mosque) with caption only; preregistered rule: a plate/blank slot is replaced by the nearest following body-text page. Decided from the page image before any OCR.

page_notes.100: Chapter-opening page (Ch. X) with a large head illustration; body text present — retained, not a plate.
page_notes.197: Chapter-opening page (Ch. XIX) with head-piece illustration; body text present.
page_notes.244: Chapter-end short page (7 lines of body text); retained.

detector.note: P16 detector reused byte-identically; no parameter changes for the new book.

pipeline: pdftoppm -gray renders at 200 (baseline text) / 300 / 360 (flag discovery only); tesseract 5.3.4 eng --psm 3; scoring = p14.normalize + Levenshtein, normalize-before-score (P16 erratum fix).
